description: Agentic Workflow — state write validation, forbidden-scope guard, dangerous-bash deny, verification gate (Trae). TEMPLATE, not loaded by Trae directly: Trae has no plugin-level hooks, so install-trae.js substitutes ${TRAE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with the installed plugin root at install time (Trae itself performs no variable substitution) and merges the hooks map into the global ~/.trae-cn/hooks.json (own entries identified by the 'agentic-workflow-trae' path marker). Trae runs command hooks in the system default shell (PowerShell on Windows); exit 2 + stderr blocks (PreToolUse deny / Stop block). timeout is in seconds; Stop loop_limit caps repeated blocks. block-dangerous-bash backfills the executor bash deny-list that Trae's nested permission.bash should already cover — kept here as defense-in-depth so all platforms share the same enforced floor.
